landing.heroTitle: Bridge the Hunger Gap. Turn Surplus into Smiles.
landing.heroSubtitle: NourishNet connects restaurants, caterers, and homes with verified local NGOs and volunteer delivery champions in real time. Zero food waste, 100% human dignity.
landing.rolesTitle: Choose How You Want to Make a Difference
landing.rolesSubtitle: Tailored dashboards and tools built for each hero in the nourishment chain
landing.donorCardDesc: Restaurants, hotels, wedding halls, and corporate cafeterias. Post surplus in 60 seconds with AI predictive forecasting to curb future waste.
landing.ngoCardDesc: Charitable trusts, community kitchens, and orphanages. Receive instant real-time radar alerts when fresh food is available within your radius.
landing.volunteerCardDesc: Community drivers and youth champions. Pick up verified claims, track live routes, and ensure fresh meals reach tables fast.
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: From kitchen surplus to community nourishment in 3 simple steps
landing.step1Desc: Donors specify food category, portions, and pickup window on the interactive map.
landing.step2Desc: Nearby registered NGOs get instantaneous push alerts and claim the food in one click.
landing.step3Desc: Volunteers transport the meal with live status milestones from pickup to handover.
landing.impactShowcaseSubtitle: Real meals, real lives touched every single day across neighborhoods
landing.galleryFeastDesc: Hot prepared meals rescued directly after functions and safely distributed.
landing.galleryProduceDesc: Supermarket surplus and orchard harvests delivered to family kitchens.
landing.galleryCommunityDesc: Hot nutrition served with warmth and dignity to those who need it most.
landing.galleryAiDesc: Machine learning forecast helping kitchens optimize preparation and cut surplus.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to Turn Food Waste into Community Hope?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join thousands of donors, NGOs, and volunteers building a hunger-free future.
landing.ctaAction: Get Started Now — It is Free
landing.footerTagline: Zero Waste • Zero Hunger • Transparent Redistribution
